name: Absent
definition: The practice is not performed, or there is no evidence that it is

name: Initial
definition: Performed ad hoc or reactively; depends on specific individuals; inconsistent; little or no documentation
typicalEvidence: E6 interviews; isolated E1 or E3 records

name: Defined
definition: Documented, approved and owned; scope and responsibilities stated; not yet consistently implemented across the declared scope

name: Implemented
definition: Implemented across the declared scope; records exist and reconcile to the definition; gaps known and tracked

name: Operating
definition: Operates consistently over a representative period and relevant states; measured; exceptions detected and handled
typicalEvidence: E3 over a representative period; exception and metric records

name: Optimised
definition: Measured against objectives and improved through incidents, tests, exercises and independent challenge; improvements demonstrated
typicalEvidence: E4 lessons; E5 independent review; improvement trends
